askPage.title: Ask
askPage.intro: Ask a question, include the records that matter, and paste the context pack into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any assistant you already use. Hearth suggests records for the kind of question you ask; you can search the health log and DNA for anything else. Hearth sends nothing itself, and names are replaced by labels unless you switch them on.
askPage.question: Your question
askPage.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Should Alex worry about clopidogrel? · Who inherited the TCF7L2 diabetes variant? · Is simvastatin a good choice for Maria?
askPage.realNames: include real names and exact ages
askPage.namesWarning: Your question mentions {names} by name; the pack labels people as Person A/B. Reword the question or switch real names on.
askPage.previewHeading: Preview — exactly what will be copied ({chars} characters, about {tokens} tokens)
askPage.copied: Copied for {destination}. Now paste it into the assistant.
askPage.openAssistant: Open the assistant yourself: <chatgpt>ChatGPT</chatgpt> · <claude>Claude</claude> · <gemini>Gemini</gemini>. These links carry no data. Consumer chat accounts may use conversations for training unless you turn that off in the provider's settings; consider doing so before pasting health information.
askPage.confirmBody: The text in the preview will be placed on your clipboard. Once pasted into a third-party service it is governed by their terms and privacy policy, not Hearth's.
askPage.confirmLogged: Recorded in the sharing log (Settings) so you can audit what left this device
askPage.confirmCopy: I have checked the preview — copy
askPage.nothingIncluded: Nothing included yet. Include suggested records above, or find any record in the health log or DNA.
askPage.searchHealth: search title, text, body part, tags
askPage.searchDna: gene, drug, condition or rsid (e.g. CYP2C19, warfarin, rs429358)
askPage.noDnaHits: Nothing in the knowledge base matches. Type an rsid to look up any SNP from the raw files.
askPage.dnaHint: Search the knowledge base, or type an rsid to look up any SNP in the raw files.
askPage.moreResults: {n} more; narrow the search to see them.
askPage.noIntent: Type a question to get suggestions: which records to include and which prompt fits.
askPage.mentionedPeople: Named in the question but not selected:
askPage.pickPeople: Select who the question is about to get record suggestions.
askPage.noSuggestions: No records match this question for the selected people. Use Find records below.
askPage.typeHint.medication: Suggests drug-response markers, current medications and diagnoses.
askPage.typeHint.labs: Suggests recent lab results and notable markers.
askPage.typeHint.symptoms: Suggests recent symptoms, measurements and medications.
askPage.typeHint.family: Suggests variants that several selected people carry.
askPage.typeHint.doctor: Suggests recent symptoms, diagnoses, medications and labs.
askPage.typeHint.report: Suggests recent letters, imaging and diagnoses.
askPage.typeHint.genetics: Suggests the markers named in the question, or notable ones.
